Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 14

“Contacts with matter, Kaunteya, produce cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They come and go and do not last — endure them, Bharata.”

A practical instruction sits inside the metaphysics. Krishna does not promise the discomfort will stop; he asks for titiksha, endurance, on the grounds that sensations are traffic, not residents.
